name: Mocboth
source:
A shouting king, a sarcastic prince, and meddling witches turn the castle into a chaotic nightmare – a parody of Shakespeare’s Macbeth.

[From [url=https://rincey.itch.io/mocboth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
咆哮的国王、爱挖苦人的王子和爱管闲事的女巫将城堡变成了一场混乱的噩梦——莎士比亚的《麦克白》的戏仿。

[来自[url=https://rincey.itch.io/mocboth]Itch.io[/url]]
